04 SU An evidence-first research engine built to challenge its own conclusions. SU is an experimental evidence-first research system for gathering sources, tracing claims, searching for contradictions and reviewing conclusions against the evidence behind them. 05 MAISOG KILAT Algorithmic trading research with deterministic testing and risk controls.
